tasks.label: Rust: cargo test (local toolchain)
args: export CARGO_HOME="${env:CARGO_HOME:-${env:HOME}/.cargo}"; export RUSTUP_HOME="${env:RUSTUP_HOME:-${env:HOME}/.rustup}"; export PATH="${env:HOME}/.cargo/bin:$PATH"; export CARGO_BIN="${env:CARGO_BIN:-$(ls -d ${env:HOME}/.rustup/toolchains/*/bin/cargo 2>/dev/null | sort | tail -n 1 || echo ${env:HOME}/.cargo/bin/cargo)}"; cd "${workspaceFolder}/rust"; "$CARGO_BIN" test --lib

tasks.label: Rust: cargo check (local toolchain)
args: export CARGO_HOME="${env:CARGO_HOME:-${env:HOME}/.cargo}"; export RUSTUP_HOME="${env:RUSTUP_HOME:-${env:HOME}/.rustup}"; export PATH="${env:HOME}/.cargo/bin:$PATH"; export CARGO_BIN="${env:CARGO_BIN:-$(ls -d ${env:HOME}/.rustup/toolchains/*/bin/cargo 2>/dev/null | sort | tail -n 1 || echo ${env:HOME}/.cargo/bin/cargo)}"; cd "${workspaceFolder}/rust"; "$CARGO_BIN" check
